notes.title: Kraino Origins Localization + Art improvement + Bug fixes
notes.content: Kraino Origins has now been localized in Spanish, French, German, & Brazilian Portuguese! Also Some levels and UI have had their art redone to look better. And some bug fixes and gameplay improvements are also in.

notes.title: Ghost boss collider fix
notes.content: Fixed issue where if player could reach top of the boss arena the camera would begin to transition.

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.content:
[list]
Adjusted some light positions for plus mode
Fixed some colliders not being triggered correctly
[/list]

notes.title: Plus Mode!
notes.content: I am happy to announce Plus Mode is now available! What is plus mode? With plus mode enabled in the video settings on main menu screen, 2d lights are enabled to add more depth and visual richness to Kraino Origins. Plus mode is compatible with all the color modes as well!

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
[list]
Fixed room not transitioning correctly on some edge cases
Added missing air attack animation 
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix 2
notes.content:
[list]
Fixed collected blue magic token not appearing in over-world 
Fixed Tinkerer Achievement not displaying once all upgrades grabbed 
[/list]

notes.title: Palette Mode Art Fix
notes.content: Fixed bug where intro images not viable when using some of the different palette modes.

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
Fixed some enemies not freezing when hit with ice axe
Minor enemy balancing
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Balancing #2
notes.content:
[list]
Gameplay balancing
Difficulty balancing
Previous sub weapon is now saved
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Balance Update
notes.content:
[list]
Adjusted sub weapon prices (lower)
Added missing spider sound effect
Enemy Damage balancing
Fixed platforms with incorrect collision placement
[/list]
